criteria.question: One clear focal point per beat; reading order is obvious.
criteria.notes: Each chapter has one dominant mechanism and a consistent takeaway dock.

criteria.question: Type roles are consistent; sizes respect the floor; no orphans or awkward breaks.
criteria.notes: Display, data, and explanatory roles remain distinct and legible in portrait.

criteria.question: Layouts are intentional in every format (not stretched or cropped landscape).
criteria.notes: The portrait-only layouts use the full vertical stage without a landscape crop.

criteria.question: Holds match reading time; rhythm varies; nothing drags or rushes.
criteria.notes: Progressive curve, drain, order flow, and seal beats support the measured narration.

criteria.question: All text is legible at delivery size with sufficient contrast.
criteria.notes: Warm paper, high contrast ink, and substantial text sizes retain readability.

criteria.question: Palette and texture follow the chosen style system and direction.
criteria.notes: The editorial-light palette is consistent across the full review grid.

criteria.question: Each transition carries meaning or continuity; none are decorative filler.
criteria.notes: Crossfades carry a shared line, order book, or circular seal across chapters.

criteria.question: Motion vocabulary is consistent across scenes.
criteria.notes: Curves, cards, mono labels and tactile scale changes make a coherent vocabulary.

criteria.question: No repetitive looping filler or motion without purpose.
criteria.notes: Motion always explains price, collateral, bid depth, or intervention.

criteria.question: No unintended static stretches; intentional holds are marked.
criteria.notes: No black gaps; every narrated chapter has progressive visual development.

criteria.question: No accidental overlaps, clipping or safe-area violations.
criteria.notes: Snapshot inspection found no clipping or safe-area collisions.

criteria.question: Clear opening, progression and ending; the last frame holds long enough.
criteria.notes: The story advances from rally to mechanism, cascade, and a restrained conclusion.

verdict: pass — 4.1/5 mean snapshot review; final media QA passed.
pass_rule: Every criterion scored 1-5 with evidence (frame or contact-sheet paths); all >= 3 and mean >= 3.5.
